notes.title: Backrooms: Reminiscence - Announcement
notes.content:
I'm glad to announce that I have started working on my next game, [b]Backrooms: Reminiscence[/b]. It's a sequel to [b]Backrooms: Exploration[/b]. The game is going to be focused on 2 main characters: [b]John Sherpardson[/b] (AKA the other robber) and [b]William Smith[/b]. I plan to add a lot of story and lore to this game as well.

It will be my last [b]Backrooms[/b] game, and I will make sure it's much better than my previous two games. This game will feature much more than [b]Backrooms: Exploration[/b] did. I plan to make almost everything interactable, since it feels the most realistic way to do a good [b]Backrooms[/b] game. I'm not sure about entities yet, but I feel like they won't be in a big role in this game. That's it for now, I'll keep you updated throughout the development phase!

Go follow me on X for teasers and sneak peeks: [url=https://x.com/Hoogan3D]HNStudios Official X[/url]

Thanks for all the support that I've gotten, you keep me motivated!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204871/3a4c972e2d161ff5b1ac861ab9ce2a50f5746c6c.png[/img]

notes.title: Backrooms: Exploration – Full Release Trailer - May 2nd
Backrooms: Exploration – Available Now on Steam
notes.content:
[b]Backrooms: Exploration[/b] is now available on Steam. Two friends have lost their jobs due to COVID-19, but they still have to bring food to the table. After a failed heist, one of them ends up in the Backrooms. Now your only mission is to survive.

Explore the backrooms, solve puzzles, and find a way to escape—if possible.

🔗 Get it now on Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3423660/Backrooms_Exploration/]Backrooms: Exploration[/url]

Join the community and share your experiences.

Welcome to the Backrooms. Try not to get lost.

notes.title: Backrooms: Exploration Store Page Is Now Live
notes.content:
The store page for Backrooms: Exploration is now officially live!
This game will be published this year, hopefully before summer. That's the plan for now,

[b]Go wishlist the game now![/b]

[h1][b]What happened to Backrooms: Found Footage 2?[/b][/h1]

- This is still the same game as Backrooms: Found Footage 2, but with a different name. It isn't really a sequel to the previous one, so it wouldn't have made any sense. Plus, I think this name is even better!

- This game is going to be a lot bigger than the previous one, making it much better. The actual gameplay is super realistic and smooth. Trust me, it will blow your mind. I will upload a trailer as soon as possible!

notes.title: Backrooms: Found Footage 2 - Announcement
notes.content:
I'm thrilled to announce my next game, [b]Backrooms: Found Footage 2[/b]! It is a sequel to the first one where things are getting even more exciting. This game will be much longer and more realistic than the first one. The game is in early development and it will not be released any time soon, but it's worth the wait. It will be a paid game, unlike the first one, though the price tag will stay under 10 dollars.

The game does not follow the happenings of the first game, it will have its own story. It takes place in the modern world, which is going to make the graphics even more realistic. That's all I can say about it for now. Here's some artwork that I made for this sequel:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204871/550d89af5a088cc9da84f06bbfb979d73375f1fd.png[/img]

Will you ever update the first game?
- Yes, I have some plans for the first game as well. There are some things that need to be fixed, though I will not make the game itself longer. I will focus on the sequel for now.

HN Studios

notes.title: Backrooms: Found Footage - Release Date
notes.content:
[b]Backrooms: Found Footage[/b] - is releasing in [b]2 weeks[/b]! Mark your calendars, for [b]October 25th[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204871/0c565ff3a73295afdeabfe7dac8ef4f1bbb9288a.jpg[/img]

I'm more than happy to announce that my first game ever is releasing this month, just in time for Halloween! This game is a short "[b]Backrooms[/b]" -experience, where you play as a [b]Young Alex[/b] who finds out that realities have collapsed between the real world and the [b]Backrooms[/b]. You're lucky to have a camera, so you can record all of the weird things you see during your journey. In this game, you have 2 different endings and it's up to you which one you decide to take. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204871/84362e41813315f58849acc8cde9dfbb49980a3d.jpg[/img]


See you on October 25th!
